stem: The number of words in History essays by students at a certain college has mean $\mu$ and standard deviation 1420.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: The mean number of words in a random sample of 125 History essays was found to be 4820. Calculate a 98% confidence interval for $\mu$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Another random sample of $n$ History essays was taken. Using this sample, a 95% confidence interval for $\mu$ was found to be 4700 to 4980, both correct to the nearest integer. Find the value of $n$.
